# Reviewed Pine engine sources

EdgeLab pins PineTS 0.11.0 under AGPL-3.0-only. The original npm package stays unchanged. `scripts/pine-engine.mjs` reconstructs its exact readable sources from the packaged browser source map and applies the reviewed files in `overrides/`. The missing, type-only Indicator barrel comes from the pinned package's declaration re-exports.

`manifest.json` seals the installed version, source-map bytes, declaration barrel, original source bytes and each modified file with SHA-256. Development and production workers use the same source resolver. A changed dependency or patch fails the build until its source and hashes are reviewed together. Imports resolve only to the verified sources and three bundled MIT dependencies; there is no network fetch or arbitrary disk fallback.

The local changes preserve `varip` declarations and object-field metadata, and provide an explicit indicator-only realtime lifecycle for deterministic engine tests. Ordinary mutable values roll back between updates; intrabar-persistent values and fields retain their appropriate state. Provisional outputs replace the current bar. `setRealtimeMode(true)` is required before `run`; `updateTail(context, { confirmed: false })` recalculates an open bar and `{ confirmed: true }` closes it. Provider bars must remain chronological. Streaming, paginated realtime and strategy tick scheduling are unsupported and fail explicitly.

The application still executes closed snapshots. The engine API does not establish live chart integration or TradingView parity. Tests cover supported scalar, collection and declared UDT field rollback, moving-average state and provisional output replacement. Full drawing-object behavior and per-tick performance budgets are not established. Upstream UDT copy helpers still reconstruct from construction values and do not reliably copy later field mutations. See `backend/tests/pine-realtime54.test.js` for actual minified-engine tests and `pine-engine-integrity54.test.js` for build integrity tests.

Modified files retain the original LuxAlgo copyright and AGPL notices, with an EdgeLab modification notice. Matching source distributions must include these overrides, manifest, build script and the locked dependency sources. See the repository licence and third-party notices.
